choice.basis: The dashboard legend maps pale yellow to the 'High' (100) end of the risk index and dark maroon to the 'Low' (0) end. Among the provided options, Rhode Island (RI) and Delaware (DE) are both colored pale yellow, indicating the highest risk level. New Mexico (NM) is dark maroon, indicating the lowest risk. The task requires routing to the 'highest-risk priority follow-up workflow.' While both RI and DE are at the highest risk level, the option for RI is explicitly labeled for 'priority follow-up,' whereas the option for DE is labeled for 'routine monitoring.' Therefore, RI is the correct record to open for the specified workflow.
choice.option_label: Open Rhode Island (RI) risk detail for priority follow-up
